objective: Contain KL Admin editor render crashes and protect unsaved local manuscript edits with account-isolated recovery, without unrelated feature modifications
productionBaselineEvidence: Production bsoc_health_events confirmed RENDER_C567C6DA on Android 1.3.4 at 2026-10-30T09:42:49Z, repeat_count=2; source main 72de1e7f16b9ccf704147c14cbd61c35d2dd94b2; installed OTA fingerprint not verified. No release authorized.
chosenApproach: KL-only React error boundary with anonymized component hint and explicit per-account local manuscript draft recovery. Preserve server-authoritative approval and media behavior.
alternativeApproaches: Suppress the global error (rejected: hides genuine faults)
Rewrite shared navigation/media pipeline (rejected: risks unrelated modules)
Save draft directly to backend on every keystroke (rejected: publication semantics and load)
preserveBehaviors: Every server-confirmed scene placement and effect remains authoritative
No Wall, Connect, Quiz or shared routing changes
No production OTA without RC preflight
acceptanceChecks: KL child render errors show local retry rather than global blank SYS-500 screen
Editor local recovery is scoped to user UUID and chapter UUID
No silent overwrite of server manuscript
Unsaved changes retain local recovery on component unmount
Server confirmed saves clear local copy without erasing newer concurrent edit
Render crash telemetry contains component allowlisted identifier, not raw manuscript or stack
Focused node tests and TypeScript validation pass
Android DEV then exact verified RC before release
selectionRationale: React subtree containment plus locally recoverable, account/chapter-isolated draft is smaller and safer than global navigation changes, automatic publishing, or a KL schema migration. Existing preview/approval remain unchanged.
